HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: World's Hardest Game 2 is a sequel to the infamous maze game, offering 50 levels of intense challenges that test your skills, timing, and strategy.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Use the arrow keys to control the red square.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Avoid colliding with moving blocks to stay in the game.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Collect all coins and reach the blue field to complete the level.
